title: IIT Mandi Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 08 Staff Nurse, Junior Technical Superintendent and other Posts
description: The Indian Institute of Technology Mandi (IIT Mandi) has issued an official notification to fill 08 Staff Nurse and Junior Technical Superintendent positions. Candidates with B.E/ B.Tech, Post Graduation, MCA, GNM, and Diploma can apply offline on or before the last date of application. Here we provide complete information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the IIT Mandi Notification 2026 .
